decisions.decision: Use generated bitmap images for the Home page What I Do cards instead of inline SVG placeholders.
decisions.rationale: The user wanted richer visual assets for Research, Teaching, and Students cards.

decisions.decision: Use a minimal symbolic approach for the Research card.
decisions.rationale: Digital image processing, blockchain, and digital forensics are easy to over-render into AI-looking visual clutter; a restrained symbolic image reads better at card size.

decisions.decision: Use a clean classroom whiteboard scene for the Teaching card and a clean student-at-whiteboard scene for the Students card.
decisions.rationale: The user liked the blue/yellow classroom direction but wanted less clutter and fewer distracting objects.
The user explicitly exempted their photo from cleanup; it was used only as a loose identity reference for the teaching image.

decisions.decision: Do not add unsupported student outcomes or testimonials.
decisions.rationale: Students Hub content must not overclaim specific outcomes without supplied or approved source material.

next_action: Open or preview index.html and visually check the three What I Do card images at desktop and mobile widths, then continue the Phase 06.5 whole-site polish pass. Do not edit Students Hub outcome specifics until real or approved interim content is supplied.
